name: bluechip Assistant and models
description: [bluechip] Assistant turns, tools and cards; model tokens, cost, latency and errors; embeddings.

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.assistant.turns`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.cost`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.errors`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.budget_exhausted`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.assistant.turns`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `surface` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.assistant.turns`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.assistant.tool_calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `tool` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.assistant.tool_calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.assistant.cards`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.tokens`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `kind` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.cost`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `model` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.cost`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `feature` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `model` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.llm.errors`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `kind` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.embeddings.calls`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.embeddings.backlog`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using last
| group using sum
